blocks.text: The useTransition hook helps you keep your React app responsive during heavy updates.
It lets you mark some state updates as "non-urgent", allowing other, more urgent updates to happen first.

items: A slow operation that might freeze the UI
Search results that take time to display

blocks.text: Here's a simple example showing how to use transitions in a search feature:

blocks.caption: Example

items: The input field updates immediately (urgent update)
The search results update is marked as a transition (non-urgent)
The loading message shows while the transition is pending

blocks.text: Here's a more practical example with a slow search feature:

blocks.caption: Example

items: When you type in the input field, it updates immediately
The search results update is wrapped in startTransition
While the results are updating, isPending is true
The UI stays responsive even with many results

blocks.text: The useTransition hook returns two items:

items: isPending: tells you if a transition is active
startTransition: function to mark updates as transitions

blocks.text: Note: Use transitions only for non-urgent updates. For example, typing in an input field should be urgent, but filtering a large list can be a transition.
